title: Willem Nolens (Founder, in24 · ex-CEO SolarNow) — Incorruptible's independent mission council idea shaping in24's governance: foundation board with a golden share
summary: Willem Nolens — 25-year impact entrepreneur, founder of in24, previously CEO of SolarNow (scaled 3 → 1,200 employees, 2011–2019) — publishes Part 4/4 of his Pulse series 'Staying True to the Mission,' crediting Incorruptible with the concrete governance model in24 now uses: a foundation board holding a golden share in the for-profit entity, with authority to intervene when the company drifts from its mission and values. Frames it as the answer to two cautionary tales from his own career (an embezzlement incident in Accra, and customer-satisfaction erosion at SolarNow as short-term sales metrics overtook long-term credit portfolio health).
blockquote: Eric Ries's brilliant book 'Incorruptible' gave me a concrete way to organise that counterweight: an independent mission council, with the mandate and authority to intervene when a company drifts from its mission and values.
